$note: Companion file to tokens/colors.json — Token Studio should import both as part of the same set collection (global.color lives in colors.json; global.spacing/border-radius/shadow/duration/easing/opacity live here). Typography tokens (fontSize/fontWeight/lineHeight/letterSpacing/typography.*) are owned by SKILL 06 (alice-typography-system) and intentionally NOT redefined here, per the skill's single-source-of-truth rule.

20.$description: Quiet Harbour direction calls for generous vertical rhythm — extended past the standard 4pt scale for Home/hero breathing room

24.$description: Largest step — reserved for the space above/below the Home points-balance hero moment

md.$description: Default container radius — echoes the brand mark's rounded-square geometry

xl.$description: Large surfaces — bottom sheets, modal cards

full.$description: Pills/avatars/badges only — never a default container radius

border-radius.$note: Deliberately soft and generous, never sharp (0-2px) corners — sharp corners would contradict the Quiet Harbour direction and the mark's own rounded-square icon.

hairline.$description: Default line weight — kept delicate per the 'unhurried, quiet' personality

thick.$description: Reserved for focus rings and the booked/held calendar-date border

subtle.$description: Opacity applied via global.opacity.subtle (6%) at the component level — the ONLY shadow in the system. Depth comes from spacing and the navy/gold palette, not shadow-card stacks, per the art direction's anti-template guardrail.
Used with shadow.subtle and hover/press background tints

icon.$note: Added per 20-design-review.md — previously only documented in prose in 16-icon-asset-spec.md, never an actual token. Icon color tokens live in colors.json (global.color / light.color.icon / dark.color.icon), not here.

normal.$description: Standard transitions — screen pushes, sheet open

confirm.$description: SIGNATURE — the gold-chevron booking-confirmation motion only (M08→M09). Deliberately slower than routine UI per art direction: this moment should feel considered, not snappy. Never reuse this duration for ordinary navigation.

standard.$description: Gentle ease-out for routine transitions — smooth deceleration, no overshoot/bounce

confirm.$description: SIGNATURE — slow, settling deceleration paired with duration.confirm for the gold-chevron motif. Pairs only with duration.confirm.

easing.$note: No spring/bounce curves anywhere in this system — explicitly forbidden by the art direction's motion-character guardrail (fluid, restrained; Direction A's mechanical snap and any spring physics are rejected).

padding-y.$description: Generous vertical padding — Quiet Harbour spacious density, larger than a typical 8-12px button

shadow.$description: Buttons never carry a drop shadow — flat, confident, no fake elevation

bg.$description: Rare — only the single highest-priority CTA on a screen (e.g. Confirm on M08) may use the gold accent button; every other action uses component.button.primary

text.$description: Always navy on gold fills — never white (fails WCAG AA, see 07-color-system.md)

radius.$description: Rounded-square glyph per date, echoing the brand icon's interlocking squares — see Signature Moments in 06-art-direction.md. Matches 11-component-specs.md and 18-figma-specs.md exactly (6px) — corrected per 20-design-review.md finding.
Pill badge — the one deliberate 'full' radius use case

confirmation-motion.$description: Wires the signature gold-chevron confirmation moment (M08→M09) — see Signature Moments row 4 in 06-art-direction.md. Feeds SKILL 10 (Motion Design) directly.

points-balance-display.$description: Numeral typeface/size is owned by SKILL 06 (Typography) — this component token only fixes the color reference; typography should use the wordmark-derived monospace treatment per 06-art-direction.md Handoff table.

shadow.$description: No card shadow by default — Quiet Harbour depth comes from spacing/tonal contrast (bg.subtle vs bg.default), not elevation. Use shadow.subtle only for a card that must visually float above other content (e.g. a bottom sheet).

active-indicator-color.$description: Subtle brass underline/dot, never a full-fill active tab icon — keeps gold rare per art direction guardrail
